text: ITEM 1 | Two thin strips, reddish-brown to dark amber with glossy, slightly caramelized surface and darker edges; flat, ribbon-like pieces with layered, slightly wavy texture, one piece about 9 cm long and 2 cm wide, the other about 10 cm long and 2 cm wide with a thinner branch; some surface sheen suggesting rendered fat, lying directly on a white square plate with no sauce or garnish | 18
